name: Chennai AI Week
heading: Chennai.
description: Chennai AI Week is a place to build, test and discuss useful AI. By Curious Commons.
intro: For people making AI useful, and those curious enough to try.
aboutTitle: From an interesting idea to something you can try.
about: Chennai’s engineers, researchers, founders and creators bring different questions to AI. We want to make room for working through them together: building, testing, sharing what works and being honest about what doesn’t.

formats.title: Build something useful
formats.text: Hands-on sessions around real problems. Bring a project, test an approach or work through a question with someone beside you.

formats.title: Look under the surface
formats.text: Conversations about models, language, design and the limits of a tool. Useful questions belong here as much as working demos.

formats.title: Find the next collaborator
formats.text: Meet people working on related problems, exchange notes and discover what others in the city are trying.

invitation: What would you like to try?
invitationText: Bring a working session, a demo, a research question or a space to gather. Help shape what the first edition becomes.

art.alt: Graphic illustration of Chennai architecture, the coast and technological forms.

faq.question: When is the first edition?
faq.answer: Dates and venues have not been announced. Follow the calendar for updates as the programme takes shape.

faq.question: Can I host a session?
faq.answer: Yes. Write to hello@curiouscommons.com with your idea, who it is for, and what you would need to run it. We will discuss the fit before anything is announced.

faq.question: How will registration work?
faq.answer: Confirmed events will have their own listings and entry requirements. Following the calendar is an update subscription, not an event ticket.
